notes.title: Driver Character Update and Additional Content
notes.notes:
[p]Your driver will no longer disappear when entering vehicles, instead he hops in and holds on for dear life with new dynamic animation! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311992/5bdd13784c58e0b32a3b633593386175e6ecd46a.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311992/ffb66236c588f9751a765aaade209f5ce07ba25b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Implemented some character customizations with different helmet options and customizable driver suit. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311992/de38d31d736ce6ee3e2611f003771f9415d194d8.png"][/img][/p][p]Added a simple fast travel system to get around the map faster. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311992/a34c1620e43233d0a85b15968e3d7dd388706855.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Added over 50 new garage items and 10 new vehicle wheel options[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311992/cf4018469e2929d05a87eafaf15a4ff914787216.png"][/img][/p][p]Have fun![/p]

notes.title: Big Physics Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Physics Update[/h1][h3]6/8/25[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311992/c1fd5c63acc07b9dfdee1b59892db6453f527561.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Implemented advanced weight system with inertia. Cars feel much more planted, controllable and less spastic. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved tire temperature and wear dynamics. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed torque cap for reverse gear and made other power adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Added buttons for testing ffb on sim devices. Still a major work in progress and not guaranteed to work just yet. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated 1999 Sedan model[/p][/*][*][p]Might have added a trophy truck..[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This update brings a much more realistic feel when driving all vehicles. The main development focus is heavily maintained on vehicle physics and overall driving experience, along with adapting ffb to all devices. I only have one basic rig to test with, so it is a slow process. As things progress, more focus will be made on content, like adding and polishing existing vehicles and locations, adding more tuning options like front and rear sway bar mods, brake bias and different gear differential options, interior and livery customization systems, achievements and much more![/p][p][/p][p]See you on the leaderboards! [/p][p]

(level work in progress) -[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311992/d987f69733d53d2cb692e15691771d08112e9d17.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311992/81e60a9567778b9ccca0932e03f01ae18f2afbd0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311992/a2640ab8958b18aa4d16bada6fdcc9217b9499d5.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Improved calibration instructions, which should fix inverted input issues. 
[*]Added a dropdown list to show all detected devices. 
[*]Added the ability to save multiple mapping profiles. 

[*]Added new wheel FX when driving over different surface materials (dirt, grass, etc). 
[/list]

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added Steering Sensitivity - Can be adjusted in the driver profile to change overall steering responsiveness. Steering speed is still also configurable per vehicle. 
[*]Made adjustments to engine/transmissions-
[*]Increased minimum available torque at rev limiter for all engines. 
[*]Simplified torque curves.
[*]Modified the physical coupling between engine and wheels. 
[/list]
